headline: Oversupply of shopping malls complicates rents in Puebla; 900 empty units: AMPI
summary: AMPI president Julio Javier Préstamo Ábrego said an oversupply of shopping centres in Puebla has left about 900 units empty and is hurting rental income for property managers.
why: Commercial property rents and vacancy rates are key measures of real estate performance and retail demand.
original_headline: Sobreoferta de plazas comerciales complica rentas en Puebla; hay 900 locales vacíos: AMPI
